# pve_ceph_osd_lv_info (Data Source)

LVM volume details of one OSD (block, db, or wal).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_ceph_osd_lv_info" "example" {
node = "pve1"
osdid = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `osdid` (Number) OSD ID

### Optional

- `type` (String) OSD device type (default: block) One of: `block`, `db`, `wal`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>/<osdid>.
- `lv_info` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lv_info))

<a id="nestedatt--lv_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `lv_info`

Read-Only:

- `creation_time` (String) Creation time as reported by `lvs`.
- `lv_name` (String) Name of the logical volume (LV).
- `lv_path` (String) Path to the logical volume (LV).
- `lv_size` (Number) Size of the logical volume (LV).
- `lv_uuid` (String) UUID of the logical volume (LV).
- `vg_name` (String) Name of the volume group (VG).
